_doc: Depth v3 6.4. One affix per Elite node, given in combat_setup.affix (the map lane picks it). Trom Mana (4) was dropped by Liam. plus=true: the affix also guarantees an Amber-tier Core offer (reward lane reads it). Effects are generic keys read by CombatEngine; add an affix by data alone when it only combines existing keys.

echo.desc_en: Repeats its last action at 70% damage.

shell.desc_en: Starts with a shield of 40% max HP.

frenzy.desc_en: Below half HP it hits 25% harder.

swarm.desc_en: Below half HP it calls 2 small allies.

rush.desc_en: Acts twice every 3 turns, shown a turn early.

fang.desc_en: Hits that pass shields add 2 poison.

ambush.desc_en: Single hits target your weakest back Axie.

chill.desc_en: Freezes one of your dice on turn 1.

iron.desc_en: Armor cuts single hits. Poison or a debuff breaks it.

spite.desc_en: Hits back when hit by a single attack.

charge.desc_en: Locks on an Axie, strikes hard on turn 4. Stun or freeze breaks it.

_doc2: group A = forces a change of faces (every Elite gets one), B = extra pressure (after boss 1 an Elite gets A + B). no_break_ok = may be drawn for a team that cannot break Plating (team_can_break false). retired = not drawn any more (thorns became spite). forbidden_pairs: charge+rush, charge+frenzy (6.7b.9).
